title: Installer commands
description: Create a project, add integrations or languages later, inspect installed features, and preview changes before applying them.

title: Dictionary API
description: Read typed dictionaries, configure active languages, and keep visitor text in separate translation domains.

title: Named and translated routes
description: Use routeNames, active child links and shared translated destinations for navigation, language switching and SEO.

title: Authentication integration
description: Configure Better Auth for an external identity service, OAuth/OIDC or project-owned users, then protect routes and server operations.

title: Authentication client
description: Call authentication methods in the browser, refresh user data and handle session changes without exposing server credentials.

title: SMTP mail integration
description: Configure a private SMTP transport and send localized messages from trusted server code.

title: Contact Action
description: Validate contact submissions, verify an optional CAPTCHA and send mail through the SMTP integration.

title: Basic Action
description: Start with a small validated Astro Action and connect it to a form with translated feedback.

title: Forms adapter
description: Use Forms and Formatter with your own controls or the optional Fields templates, keeping submission logic in its owning section.

title: Maintained content catalog
description: Explore the maintained local and remote content examples. Generated projects receive only the source selected during installation.

title: API transport
description: Validate REST responses, handle transport failures and keep private API configuration on the server.

title: Live content catalog
description: Build a typed Live Collection loader that validates upstream data and distinguishes missing entries from request failures.

title: CAPTCHA verification
description: Verify Turnstile or reCAPTCHA tokens in trusted server code before accepting a protected operation.

title: Content Action catalog
description: Adapt the maintained API read/write Action examples to a real backend, with validation and authorization checks.

title: Box
description: Center content and control its width with default, narrow, wide and fluid container sizes.

title: Section
description: Create a labeled page section with an anchor and consistent vertical spacing, independently of content width.

title: H
description: Render a semantic heading and select its visual size without changing the document outline.

title: Link
description: Create links with native attributes, locale-aware internal URLs and explicit handling for downloads or resolved destinations.

title: Button
description: Render a native button with clear type and size options, accessible labels and predictable disabled behavior.

title: Fields
description: Compose translated native form controls with labels, hints and errors, then connect them to Forms when needed.

title: Theme
description: Initialize the color theme before paint and add a switch that follows system or saved preferences.

title: LanguagePicker
description: Let visitors choose an active language and supply matching URLs when content has translated slugs.

title: PageLoader
description: Show and control the optional loading overlay, including custom ldrs animations and reduced-motion behavior.

title: FaIcon
description: Render selected Font Awesome SVG icons with accessible labels or mark decorative icons appropriately.

title: SEO
description: Set page metadata, canonical and translated URLs, social previews and structured data through the shared layout.

title: GTM
description: Configure deferred Google Tag Manager loading and cookie preferences with separate analytics and advertising consent.

title: Captcha
description: Render Turnstile or reCAPTCHA, collect its token and reset the widget through its client API.
